name: labelmuster
title: labelmuster
blurb: scan a Bluesky account's labels — self-applied flags and every third-party labeler's calls, checked against the full moderation-labeler directory, not just Bluesky's own default — pick one from a dropdown, and see a table of everyone in its follows/followers who carries the same one. @psingletary.com asked for it after a thread about middleearth.quest factions like the Noldor wanting group chats but not being able to find each other among 500 people.
